Get Started

For General Contractors

See problems before they hit

We help you analyze your project emails in real time and flag risks before they turn into delays, disputes, or cost overruns.

Get Started

Designed for the construction industry, not adapted from somewhere else.

Our AI continuously scans your project emails and flags patterns that historically lead to delays, cost overruns, or escalations weeks before they surface on site.

  • Automatic scanning of all project communication, surfacing the threads that matter.
  • Risk scoring based on language and context to flag what's likely to escalate.
  • Works with your existing email setup without disrupting how teams communicate.

When a risk surfaces, your team gets more than an alert. Every flag comes with the context, the contract reference, and a recommended next step, so the right action is never more than one click away.

  • Linked email threads, contract clauses, and schedule impact gathered into one view per risk.
  • Suggested response drafts and escalation paths grounded in your project's documents.
  • One click handover to the right owner on your team, with the full reasoning attached.

Over time, the system builds a comprehensive risk profile for each project. You see which subcontractors generate the most friction, which project phases carry the highest risk, and where patterns repeat across your portfolio.

  • Contractor performance built from real communication history, not gut feeling.
  • Recurring patterns across your portfolio surfaced as benchmarks for new projects.
  • Lessons learned captured automatically, searchable when the same situation comes up again.

AI-powered risk detection across all project communication channels.

Concrete recommendations to resolve issues before they escalate.

Every construction project generates thousands of emails. Most risks hide in plain sight across inboxes. Our AI connects the dots and gives your team the time to act before small issues become expensive problems.

Questions general contractors ask us

If you have further questions, please reach out via our Contact page.

Contact us
How does the system access our project emails?

We integrate directly with your existing email setup: Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. No migration, no new tools. Your team keeps working as usual while our AI monitors in the background.

Is our email data secure?

Yes. All data is processed in encrypted environments and never shared with third parties. We comply with GDPR and can deploy on-premise if your security requirements demand it.

How early can risks actually be detected?

On average, our system flags risks 2 to 4 weeks before they escalate into delays or cost overruns. The more project data it processes, the more accurate it becomes.

Does this work for projects already in progress?

Absolutely. The system can ingest historical email threads and start identifying patterns from day one. You don't need to start a new project to see results.

What kind of risks does it detect?

Schedule delays, cost escalations, contractual misalignments, scope disputes, and compliance gaps. Anything that leaves a trace in written communication between project stakeholders.

Do we need to change how our team communicates?

No. That's the point. Your team writes emails as they always do. The AI reads between the lines and surfaces what humans tend to overlook when managing multiple workstreams at once.
